tasks.subject: Write shared foundation: go.mod, config, tiktok types, errors, liveurl ordering
tasks.description: Blocking first step. No fan-out is possible until the shared types and interfaces exist, because all three workstreams import them. Files: go.mod, internal/config/config.go, internal/tiktok/types.go, internal/tiktok/errors.go, internal/tiktok/liveurl.go + liveurl_test.go. Semantics from reference: quality ordering by `level` desc with unknown=-1, legacy fallbacks FULL_HD1,HD1,SD2,SD1, then hls, rtmp, dedup preserving order.

tasks.subject: Delegate: HTTP client + TikTok API endpoints (internal/tiktok)
tasks.description: Agent slice. client.go (cookie jar, proxy, Chrome headers), api.go (tikrec sign fallback, check_alive, room/info, followers pagination, sec_uid, country block, stream open). Disjoint files from other slices.

tasks.subject: Delegate: capture loop + ffmpeg + telegram upload

tasks.description: Agent slice. internal/cli/flags.go mirrors reference argparse validation rules exactly, internal/cli/flags_test.go, internal/logx/logx.go (stdout INFO, stderr ERROR, rotating file 5MB/3 backups). Disjoint files. main.go I integrate myself after API and record land.

tasks.subject: Integrate main.go + orchestrator (modes, multi-user, signals)
tasks.description: Own the wiring myself after slices land: manual/automatic/followers mode loops, goroutine registry with mutex for multi-user, first-signal graceful stop and second-signal hard exit, country-check ordering, banner, update check.
